assertion.statement: A finite-dimensional nilpotent real Lie algebra has a simply connected BCH group with global exponential coordinates; homogeneous upward-closed word ideals exponentiate to closed connected normal subgroups. The explicitly corrected weighted thresholds define a taut rational degree–rank filtration.
assertion.objects: Free real Lie algebra on finite core, linear-petal and discarded-petal letters, weighted truncation u, U=exp(u), U_(d,r).
assertion.hypotheses: Positive integer letter weights; discard w>m or w=m and length>R; finite alphabet; m>=1 and 1<=R<=m.
assertion.quantifiers: For every such alphabet and every admissible degree–rank index, including (0,0).
assertion.parameter_range: d,r nonnegative integers with 0<=r<=d; positive-degree rank zero equals rank one; length may be one.
assertion.uniformity: Only fixed m,R and the labelled dimension vector determine these groups.
assertion.constants: Nilpotency class at most m; there is no asymptotic or numerical estimate.
assertion.normalizations: [x,y]=x^-1 y^-1 xy; x^t=exp(t log x); weights sum over actual entries; all w>d words are included without a rank restriction.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Trivial and missing generator families allowed; top group may be trivial; no quotient kernel is assumed central.
assertion.limit_order: Construct all real groups and lattices before taking any limit orbit.

assertion.statement: Basic group commutators give integer normal forms in free nilpotent groups, and their fixed-length classes form a free abelian lower-central basis. This yields integral Hall coordinates, lattices, and exact lattice intersections for the upward-closed monomial quotients used here.
assertion.objects: Free nilpotent group of class m, associated graded Lie ring, free real Lie algebra, finite Hall list, discrete group Lambda generated by exp letters.
assertion.hypotheses: Finite ordered alphabet; nilpotency class at most m. Uniqueness and graded independence are used only for the free group. Additional relations are exactly sums of upward-closed individual-letter multidegrees.
assertion.quantifiers: For every such quotient and every further upward-closed homogeneous subgroup S.
assertion.parameter_range: All integer exponents, all real coordinate parameters, all permitted finite alphabet sizes, including zero survivors.
assertion.uniformity: Coordinate maps, lattices and fundamental sets depend only on the fixed Hall list and the forbidden multidegrees.
assertion.constants: The coordinate inverse is a finite triangular polynomial; compact representatives use [0,1]^v. No unspecified finite computation is used.
assertion.normalizations: Tointon weight is bracket length; manuscript weight w is a separate positive grading. The ordered group-commutator coordinate need not be a single homogeneous Lie word.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Discarded Hall factors vanish including their BCH corrections. Saturation is proved for these monomial ideals, not asserted for arbitrary rational quotients.
assertion.limit_order: Integral coordinate proof is over standard real groups before any ultrapower.

assertion.objects: Universal U with core C, linear petals L, independent petals B; T=U_(m,R); eta:T to R; final sunflower frequency representation.

assertion.quantifiers: Every top commutator of the specified bad type, for every allowed generator tuple; other bracketings follow by Jacobi at the top layer.
assertion.parameter_range: m=s-1, R=r_* with 1<=R<=m. The annihilation input is only on top weight m and length R.
assertion.uniformity: A single fixed eta and labelled dimension vector for the selected dense subfamily; independent of h and N.
assertion.constants: Vanishing is exact real zero, not merely zero modulo integers.

assertion.statement: An integral character on a rational central top torus admits a finite-dimensional smooth unit-vector-valued function with that vertical frequency.
assertion.objects: Compact quotient Q/Delta, central rational top group T, character eta integral on Delta intersect T.
assertion.hypotheses: Q connected simply connected nilpotent; Delta lattice; eta continuous real homomorphism integral on the top lattice.
assertion.quantifiers: For every fixed such quotient and character; for all points and every top-group element.
assertion.parameter_range: Any finite dimension, including a trivial top group or zero character.
assertion.uniformity: Dimension and Lipschitz norm depend only on fixed geometry and character, not the polynomial orbit.
assertion.constants: Finite atlas and normalized sum of squares of bump functions; no bound uniform over unbounded characters.
assertion.normalizations: e(t)=exp(2 pi i t); the output has Euclidean norm exactly one at every point.
assertion.exceptional_cases: A scalar cutoff by itself does not retain norm one; the later completion uses two blocks of the same vertical character.
assertion.limit_order: Choose the geometric function before N and h; use natural extension on all limit points.

assertion.quantifiers: For every fixed comparison filtration group and its top quotient.

assertion.statement: Polynomial sequences are closed under multiplication and inversion and have Taylor coefficients in their indexed groups; the i-th horizontal Taylor map is a homomorphism into G_(i,1)/G_(i,2).
assertion.objects: Normalized a_h, lattice-valued correcting polynomial, E_h,i, b_h, ratio of the two third-coordinate sequences, comparison filtration H.
assertion.hypotheses: Taut rational degree–rank filtration; sequences start at one after the stated normalization; positive Taylor coefficient membership in the relevant degree filtration.
assertion.quantifiers: Every integer n and every finite coefficient list satisfying the filtration conditions.
assertion.parameter_range: All i>=1 up to the nilpotency degree; rank2 at i=1 means the next index (2,0).
assertion.uniformity: No bound on real polynomial coefficients is required; h changes the polynomial, not H or the test-function bound.
assertion.constants: Binomial normalization binom(n,i), including negative integer n; no finite-difference constant is introduced.
assertion.normalizations: Horizontal vector equality is obtained by explicit lattice lifts; equality modulo lattice alone is not substituted into the generated subgroup.
assertion.exceptional_cases: A ratio with zero horizontals has Taylor coefficient in G_(i,2), and its zeroth coefficient must be one. The smaller degree filtration has zeroth group G_(1,2).
assertion.limit_order: Fixed choice of a lattice lift defines the family before natural extension; identities persist on all limit integers.
